headline: Apollo, the investment firm, says it is listening to local opposition to AI data centres while still backing them with finance.
score_reason: Pool score 5 kept: an executive's interview; the company's own view, with no independent check in the text.
importance_line: It matters to communities that host data centres and to households worried about utility bills, but it is the investor's own account of its plans, not an independent finding.
summary: Bloomberg reports, from a Bloomberg Television interview, that Olivia Wassenaar, Apollo's global head of infrastructure, says the investment firm is working to stop local opposition derailing AI infrastructure financing. She also said Apollo worries more about falling behind on infrastructure investment than about overbuilding, and that natural gas will be used for a long time.
